text: I run a small specialty coffee roastery in Austin, Texas, buying green beans from Brazil and selling 12 oz bags to about 45 local cafés and grocers, around 300 bags a week. A bag sells for $13 wholesale and the beans, roasting and packaging cost me about $7.80. Beans take about 5 weeks to arrive by sea; I keep about 3 weeks of stock and could put about $12,000 into more. My main rival, Capital City Coffee, charges $12.50 a bag.
